prayerExcerpt.en-US: O God, who wonderfully chose the Priest Saint John Eudes to proclaim the unfathomable riches of Christ.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Ó Deus, de modo admirável escolhestes o presbítero São João Eudes para anunciar as insondáveis riquezas de Cristo.

meta.face: A Norman priest of about sixty-five with a fair, lightly ruddy complexion and a LONG, POINTED-OVAL face under a LARGE, SMOOTH BALD DOME — a high, rounded forehead, a narrow fringe of short grey hair above the ears, a long, straight nose with a gently rounded tip, heavy-lidded, half-lowered pale-grey eyes under thin, raised, arched grey brows, marked folds from the nose to the corners of the mouth, a thin mouth with a faint, knowing, kindly smile; a small grey moustache and a short, narrow grey GOATEE on the chin, the cheeks shaven; a shrewd, warm, faintly amused look toward the viewer.
meta.basis: The seventeenth-century portrait on Wikipedia, which we checked, shows a bald old priest in a black cassock and white rabat with a small grey moustache and goatee, heavy-lidded eyes and a faint smile, holding a flaming heart and a crucifix. He was born in Normandy and founded his seminary and congregations at Caen, hence the background.
